Nehemiah, book of Nehemiah. A man heard bad news, wept, prayed, confessed, and a king's cup became a way back to a ruined wall, not by fake courage alone, by prayer, planning, and working with a sword in one hand and a tool in the other. The enemy will mock and threaten, and still the people said, the God of heaven, he will prosper us, and the wall was finished, because God had moved hearts. If your life feels in ruins, start with an honest Nehemiah prayer, then take the next brick of obedience.
